mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_change_log (biz_type, biz_id, field_name, field_label, old_value, new_value, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.bizType}, #{i.bizId}, #{i.fieldName}, #{i.fieldLabel}, #{i.oldValue}, #{i.newValue}, #{i.createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM sys_change_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.create_by WHERE l.biz_type = #{bizType} AND l.biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
